title: 净明派净字符挂件
summary: 以一个「净」字纹样为中心，让简洁的线条承载对澄明的向往。
summary_en: A flowing Jing symbol expresses a quiet appreciation for clarity and reflection.
body:
这款挂件以原图标示的净明派「净」字符为中心，四角辅以卷云式装饰。舒展的线条与沉静的底色形成对照，呈现一枚以书写形态为主角的佩饰。

「净」的文化意涵为日常提供一个关于澄明与自省的提醒。宗教传统中的意义应与实际商品规格分开理解，图片不代表对材质或任何效果的认证。
body_en:
The supplied photograph identifies the central motif as the Jing character of the Jingming tradition. Flowing lines are framed by curled corner ornament, giving the written symbol a quiet visual presence.

The idea of clarity offers a point for personal reflection. Religious meaning is distinct from product specifications: the image does not certify a material or promise a particular effect.
